content:
[原文：Apple today released a new version of its Apple Invites app for iPhone. The update takes advantage of new features in iOS 27, including enhanced photo sharing and Image Playground capabilities.]

[原文：Here is Apple's full announcement of the Apple Invites update today:]

  • [原文：Shared Albums now support full-resolution sharing, so you can relive every moment in ultra-high-definition detail within the app. Anyone can join and contribute, even if they don't have an Apple device.]
  • [原文：Image Playground can now help you create high-quality backgrounds in any style, including hyper-realistic effects, so your invitations perfectly capture the mood you envision.]
  • [原文：Guests who need email verification can now click a link directly from their inbox instead of entering a verification code, making it easier to attend events.]
  • [原文：This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.]

[原文：Apple Invites is available to download from the App Store. Creating invitations requires an iCloud+ subscription, but anyone can RSVP.]
